title: Target Sum
summary: Attach either a plus or minus sign to every indexed element.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–20 integers in [0,1000] with total at most 1000. The target is in [−1000,1000].

statement: Attach either a plus or minus sign to every indexed element. Count the assignments that evaluate to the target. The two sign choices for a zero are distinct.

examples.explanation: Either sign on zero gives the same numeric result.
Either index can receive the plus sign.

constraints: 1–20 integers in [0,1000] with total at most 1000. The target is in [−1000,1000].
hints: Conceptual: The positive and negative groups together contain every index.
Directional: The positive group must sum to (total + target)/2.
Implementation: Count subsets of that sum in descending order, including both ways to handle every zero.
complexityAnalysis: O(nS) time and O(S) space, with S the sum of the input.
